f3_program: collection("magdalena.apple_tree.apples", "apple", "magdalena.apple_tree", source("the apple tree yield was excellent, and it grew 200 apples"))
produce("grow_this_year", "magdalena.apple_tree", at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "current"), 200, source("it grew 200 apples"))

remove("pick_day_1", "magdalena", at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("grow_this_year", "quantity"), 1, 5), source("Magdalena picked 1/5 of the fruits on the first day"))

remove("pick_day_2", "magdalena", at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "current"), scale(event_field("pick_day_1", "quantity"), 2), source("Magdalena picked 1/5 of the fruits on the first day, twice that number on the second day"))
offset("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.picked.day_3.count", event_field("pick_day_1", "quantity"), 20, "count", source("20 more apples than he picked on the first day on the third day"))

remove("pick_day_3", "magdalena", at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "current"), "magdalena.apple_tree.apples.picked.day_3.count", source("Magdalena picked 1/5 of the fruits on the first day, twice that number on the second day, and 20 more apples than he picked on the first day on the third day"))
query("remaining_count", "magdalena.apple_tree.apples", "current")
assumptions: The pronouns "their" and "he" refer to Magdalena, and "the fruits" are the 200 apples grown by the tree.
Answering requires converting 280 days into weeks, but the necessary day-to-week conversion is not stated and is outside the F3-v1 allowlist.

f3_program: collection("gecko.feeding_cycle.crickets", "cricket", "gecko.feeding_cycle", source("A gecko eats 70 crickets every three days"))
observe(at("gecko.feeding_cycle.crickets.count", "initial"), 70, "count", source("70 crickets every three days"))
observe(at("gecko.feeding_cycle.duration", "stated"), 3, "day", source("every three days"))
percent_of("gecko.feeding_cycle.crickets.consumed.day_1.count", at("gecko.feeding_cycle.crickets.count", "initial"), 30, source("The first day she eats 30% of the crickets"))
consume("eat_day_1", "gecko", at("gecko.feeding_cycle.crickets.count", "current"), "gecko.feeding_cycle.crickets.consumed.day_1.count", source("The first day she eats 30% of the crickets"))
offset("gecko.feeding_cycle.crickets.consumed.day_2.count", event_field("eat_day_1", "quantity"), -6, "count", source("The second day she eats 6 less than the first"))
consume("eat_day_2", "gecko", at("gecko.feeding_cycle.crickets.count", "current"), "gecko.feeding_cycle.crickets.consumed.day_2.count", source("The second day she eats 6 less than the first"))
consume("eat_day_3", "gecko", at("gecko.feeding_cycle.crickets.count", "current"), at("gecko.feeding_cycle.crickets.count", "current"), source("the third day she finishes up the remaining crickets"))
query("value", event_field("eat_day_3", "quantity"))
assumptions: The 70 crickets are the collection distributed across the stated three-day feeding cycle.

f3_program: collection("marcus.commission.paintings", "painting", "marcus.commission", source("Marcus has received a commission for as many paintings as possible"))
observe(at("marcus.commission.duration", "planned"), 5, "day", source("he paints for 5 days"))
produce("paint_day_1", "marcus", at("marcus.commission.paintings.count", "current"), 2, source("On the first day, he paints 2 paintings"))

produce("paint_day_2", "marcus", at("marcus.commission.paintings.count", "current"), scale(event_field("paint_day_1", "quantity"), 2), source("He then paints every day and each day, he paints twice as many paintings as he painted the day before. If he paints for 5 days"))

produce("paint_day_3", "marcus", at("marcus.commission.paintings.count", "current"), scale(event_field("paint_day_2", "quantity"), 2), source("He then paints every day and each day, he paints twice as many paintings as he painted the day before. If he paints for 5 days"))

produce("paint_day_4", "marcus", at("marcus.commission.paintings.count", "current"), scale(event_field("paint_day_3", "quantity"), 2), source("He then paints every day and each day, he paints twice as many paintings as he painted the day before. If he paints for 5 days"))

produce("paint_day_5", "marcus", at("marcus.commission.paintings.count", "current"), scale(event_field("paint_day_4", "quantity"), 2), source("He then paints every day and each day, he paints twice as many paintings as he painted the day before. If he paints for 5 days"))
query("sum", "marcus.commission.paintings", "current")
assumptions: The five-day painting period includes the stated first day, and the daily doubling continues through day five.

f3_program: collection("uf.previous_games", "game", "uf", source("their previous 24 games"))
observe(at("uf.previous_games.count", "total"), 24, "game", source("previous 24 games"))
observe(at("uf.previous_games.points.count", "total"), 720, "point", source("they scored a total of 720 points during their previous 24 games"))

rate_relation(at("uf.previous_games.points.count", "total"), "uf.previous_games.points.per_game", at("uf.previous_games.count", "total"), source("they scored a total of 720 points during their previous 24 games"))

offset("uf.championship_game.scored_points.count", fraction("uf.previous_games.points.per_game", 1, 2), -2, "point", source("they scored 2 points less than half as much as they had previously scored in each of the 24 games"))

add("uf_championship_scoring", "uf", at("uf.championship_game.points.count", "current"), "uf.championship_game.scored_points.count", source("they scored 2 points less than half as much as they had previously scored in each of the 24 games"))
offset("uf.championship_game.opponent.scored_points.count", event_field("uf_championship_scoring", "quantity"), -2, "point", source("Their opponent only lost by 2 points"))
query("value", "uf.championship_game.opponent.scored_points.count")
assumptions: The comparison with what UF scored in each prior game refers to its per-game rate across the previous 24 games.
An opponent losing by 2 points means its championship score was 2 points below UF's score.
